caption: The drawing depicts an architectural detail of a gallery railing with a segment of the building’s exterior wall and a shuttered window in the background, rendered in black and sepia tones. The main focus is a decorative cast iron railing featuring vertical posts topped with ornate scrollwork and floral motifs, connected by curved horizontal elements. The post at the corner is larger and more elaborately designed, ending in a finial. To the left of the railing, a window with horizontal slats (shutters) is partially visible, framed by simple molding, with a handle at the lower right of the left shutter. Below the window, the stuccoed wall surface shows cracking, and a small, rectangular vent with vertical slats is visible near the base. The floor appears to be stone or concrete and is lightly sketched with lines and cracks. On the right side, a rectangular label with the words "GALLERY RAILING" is written in uppercase letters. The right edge of the drawing is unfinished, tapering into a blank background.
title: Cast Iron Gallery Rail
